evals.expected_output: A prioritized review that catches SQL injection, authorization failure, error handling issues, and proposes focused tests.
expectations: The response identifies SQL injection/string interpolation and recommends parameterized queries.
The response identifies the missing authorization/ownership check.
The response assigns severity or prioritizes the findings.
The response proposes focused tests rather than claiming the patch is fixed.

checks.text: The selected skill is available to the treatment and absent from the baseline.
Does not modify the disposable project.
Identifies SQL injection and parameterized queries.
Identifies the missing ownership or authorization check.
Assigns severity or priority to findings.
Proposes focused tests without claiming the patch is fixed.

rubric.description: Severity-aware findings grounded in the supplied diff.

anchors.1: Misses the central task requirement or gives generic advice.
anchors.3: Addresses the main requirement with some actionable detail.
anchors.5: Provides specific, internally consistent, task-grounded guidance with useful tradeoffs.

rubric.description: Does not rewrite or falsely claim the patch is fixed.

anchors.1: Overclaims, changes scope, or ignores constraints.
anchors.3: Mostly respects the stated boundary but leaves material ambiguity.
anchors.5: Clearly separates evidence, assumptions, scope, and verification without overclaiming.
